> A student's personal project. It is not an official Zhejiang University product and has no ties to the operators of the university's systems.

Adds three sidebar pages (timetable, campus affairs, learning) and a Profile page in Settings. Each row below can be turned on or off on its own; click a row's name to configure it.

To get started:

1. Fill in your unified identity and WebVPN accounts under the campus account row. Other platforms' accounts go in their own rows.
2. Set up a model in DeepSeek Harness's settings.
3. Ask the assistant to set up your campus profile. It organizes your courses, platform links and course groups. You can also ask about your timetable, homework and notices without doing this.

Anything that changes your accounts, such as enrolling or submitting homework, only runs when you clearly ask for it, and needs your approval first. Your accounts and data stay on your computer.

See the [project page](https://github.com/Anchorite-no/dsh-zju-assistant#readme) for the full guide (in Chinese).
